Huh...?[XENO:n ]
Well, that's odd...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What's the matter, Shulk?[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The kit is missing. I could've sworn[XENO:n ]
I saw one right here...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

That could be one explanation...[XENO:n ]

...Oh? Shulk, look.[XENO:n ]

So there is...[XENO:n ]

It's an inventory of military goods...[XENO:n ]

Hmm...[XENO:n ]
I may be wrong, but I do think there was[XENO:n ]
a guard by that name in the regiment.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

According to the inventory, he's meant to[XENO:n ]
be working to recover materiel from a
number of caches on the Giant God's Shoulder.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Maybe he was the one who[XENO:n ]
took the kit as well...?[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I don't think we have any other leads.[XENO:n ]
Does the note list an itinerary?[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Hm. He might be in Nerthis Necropolis.[XENO:n ]
It's the only one on the list of caches[XENO:n ]
without a tick next to it.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Then it is decided.[XENO:n ]

miss each other on the way...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
